root_cause: The harness's source_digest hashes the Stremio behaviorHints.filename of each playable stream; stremio/schemas.py _build_behavior_filename appends the stream's media attribute ids, which Tech Info enrichment adds. So the digest changes exactly where enrichment differs: t20 warm (C0 never enriched, C6 enriched from the background-filled cache) and t10f (failure draws differ per repetition seed, in both arms). Every request of every run returned the same 12 torrents (4 per tracker), and the digest is a function of the rendered streams in every (variant, kind, index). The check conflated attributes with source identity; it is a harness defect, not a product difference.
